verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's Gateway exposes programmatic surfaces: an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, a tools-invoke HTTP API, an A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding and MCP serve, so the axis applies. But the /v1 path only mirrors OpenAI's convention, and A2A 1.0 is an external protocol version. Nothing in the pack documents OpenClaw's own API versioning scheme or deprecation policy; 'versioned state' refers to state, not APIs, the releases page lists only features, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
